audit.why: Difficulty 8/10 HARD is right for the lane phase: Quinn pokes from 1025 range with Blinding Assault, disengages with Vault (E) on 12/11/10/9/8s, and Kassadin has no gap-closer until 6. The 46.71% Emerald+ figure is the average of a lost lane and a won late game, which is what the page describes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicted its own captions. content win[] read Quinn,Quinn,Quinn,Quinn,Skill,Quinn,Quinn and full.phases sides matched, but whys[2] says 'a survivable stalemate, not a win for either side', whys[3] says 'neither side commits', whys[4] says 'tilt the lane your way', whys[5] says 'the lane flips on your power spike' and whys[6] says 'she falls off and you delete her'. full.phases[6].why even reads 'The monster is awake... best scaling champion in the lobby. Hunt.' under side Quinn.
audit.why: Kassadin's spikes are Level 6 (Riftwalk), Rod of Ages and 2+ items; Quinn itemises pure damage and falls off. Every prose field on both layers already says Kassadin owns the game from 6 onward — only the side labels disagreed.
audit.corrected: Sides realigned to the text they caption: Level 3 and Levels 4-5 to Skill, Level 6 / First item / Two+ items to Kassadin, on both content win[] and full.phases[].side. No why-text was rewritten to create the shift — the shift was already written.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interaction errors, each repeated across many fields. (a) The full layer calls her E 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' in twelve places — Vault does not blind. Riot: 'Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed... leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it.' The nearsight is Blinding Assault (Q), 1025 range. The content layer repeats the same conflation ('she dashes in with Vault (E), nearsights you'). (b) tradeGood, dosFull[0] and dosFull[1] tell you to soak her poke with Void Stone and the Null Sphere shield — both only reduce magic damage, and Quinn's whole kit is physical. (c) breakdown.late says 'Q-silence the counterplay' — Null Sphere has no silence.
audit.why: Riot's Null Sphere text: 'dealing damage and interrupting channels... a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.' Riot's Void Stone text: 'takes reduced magic damage.' Quinn's kit lists physical damage on Q, E and Harrier and no magic component anywhere.
audit.corrected: Vault is now labelled Vault (E) and described as gap-close plus escape; Blinding Assault (Q) is credited with the nearsight and its 1025 range; the shield/passive lines now say plainly that neither touches her poke and that Bone Plating and Second Wind are the real mitigation; the silence claim is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. Every line said 'fight while Vault is down' without ever giving the number.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8s and it is the single cooldown that decides whether your Riftwalk commit connects.
audit.corrected: Vault's 12s-to-8s cooldown is now stated in breakdown.cooldowns, winCon/report[1], report[5] and loading, and the trade line is keyed to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: content late called Behind Enemy Lines 'her global ult' and wants.foe[1] said she roams 'with her global ult'. It is not global — Riot describes a flight form, and the kit carries no global flag (compare Shen's Stand United, which does).
audit.why: Behind Enemy Lines is flagged as a channel. Null Sphere's Riot text says it interrupts channels, so a single Q on the take-off cancels the roam. That is a real, unstated lever in a matchup where her map pressure is the thing that beats you.
audit.corrected: The 'global' claim is removed and replaced with the interrupt: Behind Enemy Lines is a channel, and Null Sphere cancels it on the take-off.

edits.before: Quinn owns these levels and you have to accept it — she dashes in with Vault (E), nearsights you so your follow-up auto misses, and her Harrier passive makes every attack on the marked target hurt while your only answer is a single Null Sphere with a 1.5s shield. Do NOT try to trade; she out-ranges everything you have. Stand at max Q range, last-hit, and time your Null Sphere shield to absorb a poke rotation. Your one consolation: she's pure AD, so your 15% magic damage reduction is wasted here — but she also can't burst you through a fresh shield in one Vault-and-auto pass if you stay topped up and refuse the all-in.
edits.after: Quinn owns these levels and you have to accept it — Blinding Assault (Q) nearsights you from 1025 range so your follow-up auto misses, Vault (E) leaps her straight back to her own attack range, and Harrier marks make every one of her autos hurt while your only answer is a single Null Sphere. Do NOT try to trade; she out-ranges everything you have. Stand at max Q range and last-hit. Note what does not help here: Void Stone and the Null Sphere shield both only cut magic damage, and Quinn is pure physical, so Bone Plating and Second Wind are your actual mitigation. Refuse the all-in and bank CS.

edits.before: This is the whole reason you suffered the early game. With 2+ items and Riftwalk maxed, her single Vault dash can't outrun your stacking recast blinks — you chase her down, ignore the kite, and an R-Q-empowered-auto combo deletes her since she itemizes pure damage and zero defense. She falls off hard while you peak, so the longer the game goes the more this is your lane. Just don't let her snowball off your rough early; ping for jungle help if she uses her global ult to roam bot and threatens to win the map before your 2-item spike lands.
edits.after: This is the whole reason you suffered the early game. With 2+ items and Riftwalk maxed, her single Vault dash can't outrun your stacking recast blinks — you chase her down, ignore the kite, and an R-Q-empowered-auto combo deletes her since she itemizes pure damage and zero defense. She falls off hard while you peak, so the longer the game goes the more this is your lane. One extra lever: Behind Enemy Lines is a channel, not a teleport, and Null Sphere interrupts channels — one Q on the take-off cancels her roam before it leaves lane.

notes: Same kit-flag misfire as the Poppy file: kassadin.json tags Null Sphere with channel: 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Riot's description says the reverse — Null Sphere interrupts channels. I have written none of the _missing-interactions rows built on that flag, and instead used the true direction (Q cancels Quinn's Behind Enemy Lines take-off). The 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' label is a champion-wide template string in kassadin.full.js — it also appears in breakdown.feeding, breakdown.trading, report[3].t, dontsFull[1].t and focus.text for this matchup, which I left alone to keep the edit set reviewable; they carry the same wrong claim and are worth a sweep.
